args.sql:
SELECT e.patref, e.timemark, a.suicrisk,
 (a.mental_health_scores->'depression'->>'phq9_score')::int AS phq9,
 (a.mental_health_scores->'anxiety'->>'gad7_score')::int AS gad7
FROM encounters e
JOIN assessmentbasics ab ON ab.abkey = e.abref
JOIN assessmentsymptomsandrisk a ON a.asrkey = ab.abkey
WHERE (e.patref, e.timemark) IN (
  SELECT patref, MAX(timemark) FROM encounters GROUP BY patref
)
LIMIT 10;

ALTER TABLE patients ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS risk_level VARCHAR(20);

UPDATE patients p
SET risk_level = 'High Risk'
WHERE p.patkey IN (
  SELECT e.patref
  FROM encounters e
  JOIN assessmentbasics ab ON ab.abkey = e.abref
  JOIN assessmentsymptomsandrisk a ON a.asrkey = ab.abkey
  WHERE (e.patref, e.timemark) IN (
    SELECT patref, MAX(timemark) FROM encounters GROUP BY patref
  )
  AND (
    a.suicrisk IN ('High','Severe')
    OR (a.mental_health_scores->'depression'->>'phq9_score')::int > 15
    OR (a.mental_health_scores->'anxiety'->>'gad7_score')::int > 15
  )
);

 (a.mental_health_scores->'depression'->>'phq9_score')::int AS phq9,

FROM encounters e
JOIN assessmentbasics ab ON ab.abkey = e.abref
JOIN assessmentsymptomsandrisk a ON a.asrkey = ab.abkey

  SELECT patref, MAX(timemark) FROM encounters GROUP BY patref

  SELECT e.patref

  JOIN assessmentbasics ab ON ab.abkey = e.abref
  JOIN assessmentsymptomsandrisk a ON a.asrkey = ab.abkey
  WHERE (e.patref, e.timemark) IN (
    SELECT patref, MAX(timemark) FROM encounters GROUP BY patref
  )

    a.suicrisk IN ('High','Severe')
    OR (a.mental_health_scores->'depression'->>'phq9_score')::int > 15

  )
